## 📖 About

This repository is a **live intelligence hub** that aggregates professional **YARA rules** for **cybersecurity analysts**, **SOC teams**, and **threat hunters**.

Every rule is developed through **deep malware analysis** and **reverse engineering**. Rules are automatically generated, validated, and published by the **Elite AI Bot**.

> ⚡ **Automated System:** This repo is continuously updated by an AI bot that monitors RSS feeds from 12 different threat intelligence sources, 24/7.
